note.seg: Aus Angelsächs. Tractat 11. Jhs., benutzt in Durhamer Chroniken (ed. Arnold Symeonis opp. II 392), in Hs. Arundel Norfolk 222, 15. Jhs. (bei Gale Hist. Angl. SS. XV p. 560), und, ausser anderen, im folg. Mittelengl., Anfang 13. Jhs., aus Hs. Oxford Jesus coll. 29 (bei Morris Old Engl. Miscell. 1872 p. 145): ... On Englelonde syndon 32 schire ... and 13{a} byscopryche and 2 erchebiscopryche, þat is alles vyftene biscopryche .... Þes XXXII schire syndon todelede on þreo lawan: on is Westsexene lawe, oþer Dene lawe, þe þrydde Mercena lawe ¶ a) richtig für 1045—1109

From an Anglo-Saxon tract of the 11th cent., used in Durham chronicles (ed. Arnold Symeonis opp. II 392), in MS Arundel Norfolk 222, 15th cent. (in Gale Hist. Angl. SS. XV p. 560), and, among others, in the following Middle English, beginning of the 13th cent., from MS Oxford Jesus coll. 29 (in Morris Old Engl. Miscell. 1872 p. 145): ... On Englelonde syndon 32 schire ... and 13{a} byscopryche and 2 erchebiscopryche, þat is alles vyftene biscopryche .... Þes XXXII schire syndon todelede on þreo lawan: on is Westsexene lawe, oþer Dene lawe, þe þrydde Mercena lawe ¶ a) correct for 1045—1109
